items.title: This Year’s Worst S&P 500 Stock Just Got a Huge Reprieve
items.summary: AppLovin beat on every line and guided higher, yet its stock has crushed investors after earnings before. Two specific markers will show whether this after-hours surge becomes a real turnaround or another post-report reversal.

items.title: FICO Q4 Earnings Beat on Scores, Pricing and Software Growth
items.summary: Fair Isaac's Q4 earnings beat estimates as mortgage pricing and software growth lift revenues, but weak mortgage volumes cloud the fiscal 2027 outlook.

items.title: I'm a Financial Expert: 5 Credit Card Risks Gen Z Is Ignoring Right Now
items.summary: Adults ages 18 to 29 are opening more credit cards than any other generation, and carrying average credit utilization rates comparable to millennials.

items.title: FICO Just Stopped Giving Guidance as It Rewrites Mortgage Pricing
items.summary: FICO beat on earnings, then went quiet on the one number that drives them. With a $0.99 rival now sharing the same pricing grid, investors must value a mortgage business whose prices only FICO can see.

items.title: FICO Q4'26 Earnings Call Highlights Pricing Uncertainty for FY27
items.summary: Fair Isaac withholds FY27 guidance amid mortgage pricing uncertainty, even as software platform growth, score adoption and strong cash flow bolster its outlook.

items.title: Fair Isaac Corp (FICO) Q4 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Record Revenue and EPS Growth Amid ...
items.summary: Fair Isaac Corp (FICO) closed fiscal 2026 with 27% revenue growth and 44% EPS growth, but withheld fiscal 2027 guidance as it transitions to bespoke mortgage pricing.

items.title: Fair Isaac Corporation (NYSE:FICO) surprises with Q3 CY2026 sales but stock drops
items.summary: Credit scoring and analytics company FICO (NYSE:FICO) announced better-than-expected revenue in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q4 2026), with revenue up 27.4% year on year to $657 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $11.10 per share was 3.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: FICO Declines to Share Guidance Amid Price Structure Change
items.summary: The credit-score provider said it is transitioning its mortgage originations pricing structure to be tailored to the individual needs of customers, rather than a single flat fee.
